item.g:title: Pip
item.g:description: Found resting for a millennium by an abandoned hearth. Whoever keeps it is visited by the sleepy warmth of that old fire.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:title: Rebi
item.g:description: Some say it rose from the smoke of an oracle's dream. The lucky few that touch it inherit a fragment of that oracle's sight.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:title: Ren
item.g:description: It was drawn from a painted toy kept beneath the northern lights. Those who carry it arrive home safely from long journeys.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:title: Zuma
item.g:description: Washed ashore on a distant coast, baked solid by the sun. The runes foretold that its namesake band were always found together.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:title: Ori
item.g:description: Sworn into being during a vow of fidelity. The covenant holds to this day, and each winter it lends its protection to the house that shelters it.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:title: Yael
item.g:description: Its name was drawn from an act of unadulterated devotion. Once held, it draws its bearer toward safety on even the most treacherous journeys.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:title: Milo
item.g:description: Hammered from the first fire, eldest of three brothers. Wherever it is set down, the younger two are never far behind.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:title: Ibi
item.g:description: First sighted suspended above the dawn horizon, when all was new and fresh. Elegant and fleeting, every likeness of it seems to dissolve into the morning mist.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:title: Eleph
item.g:description: It was unearthed mid-stride, perennially frozen in triumph. A deep, heavy rumbling can still be felt at the place it was discovered.
item.g:google_product_category: Home & Garden > Decor > Artwork > Sculptures & Statues

item.g:description: Salvaged from the silver mirrored vessel of stellar origin. All those who wear it are seized by an insatiable wanderlust.
